# A failing command fails the run with its exit status, shows its output,
# stops its dependents, and runs again next time.
! bit
stdout '^ *fail ▶ '
stdout '^ *fail │ before$'
stdout '^ *fail │ to stderr$'
stdout '^ *fail ✘ command exited with exit status: 3$'
stderr '^error: BUILD\.bit:1:1: target ''fail'' apply failed: command exited with exit status: 3$'
! stdout 'after ▶'
! exists after.txt

! bit
stdout '^ *fail ▶ '
! exists after.txt

# Once it succeeds, its dependents run.
cp fixed.txt status.txt
bit
stdout '^ *fail ✔ ok$'
stdout '^ *after ▶ '
exists after.txt

-- BUILD.bit --
fail = exec {
  command = "echo before; echo 'to stderr' >&2; exit $(cat status.txt)"
  inputs = ["status.txt"]
}

after = exec {
  command = "touch after.txt"
  depends_on = [fail]
}
-- status.txt --
3
-- fixed.txt --
0
